territories.watershed_rule: right two thirds of the measured transverse segment -> SMA, left third -> IMA; the splenic flexure therefore sits in the SMA/IMA watershed (Griffiths point), the classical watershed of ischaemic colitis
territories.split_note: the boundary between superior-rectal (portal) and middle/inferior-rectal (systemic) territory is a DECLARED 45% split of the measured rectal length; it is not an image measurement

flows.Q_IMA_source: Mirk P. et al., Sonographic and Doppler assessment of the inferior mesenteric artery: normal morphologic and hemodynamic features, 1998 (PMID 9663270): mean flow volume 0.13 +/- 0.06 L/min

flows.assumption: the SMA-colic flow is NOT a published measurement: it is the measured proximal colon length times the flow-per-unit-length implied by the published IMA flow over the measured distal colon length. Equal flow per unit colon length is a DECLARED assumption.

calibres.note: trunk calibres are published values; r per unit flow weight is DERIVED from them so that every downstream radius follows from Murray alone

marginal_artery.note: the marginal artery of Drummond is an ANASTOMOTIC ARCADE, i.e. a loop. Murray's law is a tree property and is not claimed for it. For flow and for the Murray audit the arcade is partitioned at the watershed midway between consecutive colic insertions and each arc belongs to the tree that feeds it; the continuous arcade is drawn as an overlay polyline on top.

vasa_recta.note: real vasa recta are spaced a few millimetres apart; 12 mm is a DECLARED sampling pitch for the rendered scene

sma_colic.name: sma_colic
sma_colic.murray_note: radii are r_unit * W**(1/3) with W the summed downstream flow weight, so r_parent**3 = sum(r_child**3) holds BY ALGEBRA. The residual above is the float64 round-off of taking a cube root and cubing it back; it is NOT a fitted or tolerated error. The 12-dp figure is reported separately because rounding to 12 decimals turns that round-off into a literal 0.0 and should not be read as an exact algebraic zero.
sma_colic.contour_anchored: ostium placed on the subject's real aortic surface; the trunk, the three colic branches, the arcade arcs and the vasa recta are CONSTRUCTED from the measured colon geometry

clearance_policy.priority: ANATOMICAL FIDELITY OUTRANKS THE GAP TARGET. Companion mesenteric artery and vein really do run a fraction of a millimetre apart, so a 1 mm wall-to-wall separation is a modelling convenience, not an anatomical constraint. No vessel was deleted, moved out of the mesocolon or taken off its course to reach it; where the target could not be met the SMALLER REAL GAP is reported.

venous_node_polish.policy: post-construction node displacement applied ONLY to venous nodes with radius > 1.5 mm (trunk-calibre runs); the vasa recta are separated at construction time by a half-pitch interleave and a circumferential offset and were not moved. No segment was deleted anywhere.

portal_vs_systemic.consequence: blood from the UPPER rectum drains through the superior rectal vein into the IMV and therefore through the liver (full first pass); blood from the LOWER rectum drains through the middle and inferior rectal veins into the internal iliac vein and the IVC and therefore BYPASSES the hepatic first pass. That is the pharmacological basis of rectal suppository dosing.
